introduction: Hello, welcome to my portfolio! Here you'll find my projects — in progress, already delivered, or planned — along with my certifications and the technologies I work with. To get started, use the terminal below. Just type or click on the desired command and press Enter. If needed, the up arrow recalls previous commands, or access 'help' to see all available options.
aboutMeText: Hi, my name is Henrique and I'm 27 years old. I graduated in International Relations from FMU (2022), but found in software development the path that truly makes sense to me. I'm currently in my 3rd semester of Systems Analysis and Development at FIAP, while working as an N1 Support Analyst at Bullla. Day to day, I investigate recurring issues in applications, propose and implement root cause fixes, and handle and resolve support tickets. I also build automations for repetitive tasks for internal teams, aiming to prevent new tickets from arising. I already have a solid grasp of PL/SQL and I'm deepening my knowledge of Java (21) and C, always guided by the same goal: becoming the best developer I can be. In my free time, I enjoy content related to sci-fi, video games and music, as well as sports in general.
